Jackpot payouts: How Mega Millions Jackpots are paid?

In the Mega Millions lottery, jackpots can be paid out in either a lump sum or an annuity.
If the winner chooses the lump sum option, they will receive a single payment that is equal to the cash value of the jackpot. The cash value is calculated by taking the total amount of the jackpot and subtracting the present value of the annuity payments. This amount is then paid out to the winner in a single payment.
If the winner chooses the annuity option, they will receive their winnings in 30 graduated payments over 29 years. The first payment is made immediately after the winning ticket is validated, and the rest of the payments are made annually. The jackpot will continue to roll over until there is a winner, at which point the prize pool will be reset to the base amount for the next drawing.
